{{Infobox character|name=Senna Ironvale|house=[[House Ironvale]]|role=Heir|age=~27|kin=[[Master Halvard]] (father)}}
'''Senna Ironvale''' is everything her house wants — fastest, boldest, most inventive of her generation — and carries a conclusion Forge Gap calls heresy: ''some things should not be rebuilt.'' Before the inexplicable she falls completely silent and does not move a muscle — the only time she doesn't try to improve something.
